topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: Fix global npm its-magic installer.sh so Linux /bin/sh (dash) no longer errors with set: Illegal option - on SSH/Docker hosts; add a documented, automatable way for dev/QA to target WSL or SSH Linux/Docker for distro-specific and container testing.
installer.sh and npm package publish pipeline; docs (runbook, developer README, remote config); optional .cursor/remote.json or scratchpad keys; scripts for connectivity probe; template parity.
Must stay POSIX-safe for sh; no secrets in repo; align with US-0064 release-targets connectivity where possible; Windows + Linux parity; do not break existing REMOTE_EXECUTION contract.
Regression: installer.sh parsed under dash; optional CI/npm prepublish check; tests or script that validates remote profile template and prints operator connect hints for WSL/SSH.
Operators can install/run its-magic on Debian-style sh without line-2 set failure; dev/QA have canonical doc + config to run tests against WSL or SSH Linux/Docker with deterministic steps.
